about: The long-awaited new installment of the Team Ninja's top-class fighting game series DEAD OR ALIVE!
With the addition of brand-new stages and characters, DEAD OR ALIVE 6 embodies and illustrates the evolution of true fighting entertainment!
For more information please visit the official website at https://www.teamninja-studio.com/doa6/us/
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
